events.title: Palmer Square Annual Tree Lighting
events.blurb: Princeton's holiday season starts with the tree lighting on the Green, about 12 miles from Trenton. Strolling holiday entertainment follows Saturday and Sunday, 1–3 p.m.
events.blurbEs: La temporada navideña de Princeton empieza con el encendido del árbol en el Green, a unas 12 millas de Trenton. El sábado y el domingo de 1 a 3 p.m. hay entretenimiento navideño ambulante.

events.title: Thanksgiving Weekend Drop-in at the State Museum
events.blurb: Free drop-in crafts in the Imagination Studio: a birch-bark-style box on Friday and a 3D painted owl on Saturday. Museum admission is free; planetarium shows are extra.
events.blurbEs: Manualidades gratis sin cita en el Imagination Studio: una caja estilo corteza de abedul el viernes y un búho pintado en 3D el sábado. La entrada al museo es gratis; el planetario se paga aparte.

events.title: Grounds For Sculpture & Holiday Artisan Market
events.blurb: The sculpture park is open all weekend, and its indoor Holiday Artisan Market runs Saturday and Sunday (included with admission). Adults $25, ages 6–17 $12, 5 and under free.
events.blurbEs: El parque de esculturas abre todo el fin de semana, y su Holiday Artisan Market bajo techo funciona el sábado y el domingo (incluido con la entrada). Adultos $25, de 6 a 17 años $12, menores de 5 gratis.

events.title: Disney's Descendants, The Musical
events.addr: 1200 Old Trenton Rd, West Windsor, NJ 08550
events.blurb: Thank You 5 Productions stages the Disney musical at Mercer County Community College's Kelsey Theatre. Rated G.
events.blurbEs: Thank You 5 Productions presenta el musical de Disney en el Kelsey Theatre de Mercer County Community College. Apto para todo público.

events.title: Trenton Ironhawks vs. Trois-Rivières Lions
events.blurb: Friday-night ECHL hockey downtown; it's Teachers & Educators Appreciation Night.
events.blurbEs: Hockey de la ECHL el viernes por la noche en el centro; es la noche de homenaje a maestros y educadores.

events.title: Trenton Ironhawks vs. Reading Royals
events.blurb: A Sunday Family Matinee with a Peanuts theme.
events.blurbEs: Una matiné familiar del domingo con temática de Peanuts.

events.title: Cadwalader Park
events.blurb: The Olmsted-designed city park, with trails and the Trenton City Museum in Ellarslie mansion.
events.blurbEs: El parque diseñado por Olmsted, con senderos y el Trenton City Museum en la mansión Ellarslie.
